stepNotes.1: Scoped to a single 728-line Hono module; 6 exports and 13 operations identified (provider.list, six ax-engine lifecycle, two download-job, auth.methods, oauth.authorize/callback).
stepNotes.2: SSRF boundary confirmed in ax-engine/connection.ts:39 (local-hostname only, no userinfo/query/fragment); attach key stored via Auth.set, plaintext config writes empty apiKey — asserted by provider-routes.test.ts:254.
stepNotes.3: PUT /ax-engine/connection auth-rollback ordering is correct (snapshot at :285, restore on Config.updateGlobal failure :295/:339). Defect F1: prepare/start handlers omit the axEngineInvalidRequest wrapper that download/delete/install use.
stepNotes.4: Every mutating route registers a body or param validator; OAuth method index uses JsonNumber(...).int().min(0) and is coercion-tested; download jobID is unvalidated but cancelDownloadJob does a safe map lookup returning 400 on miss.
stepNotes.5: List/connection/auth/OAuth endpoints use concrete zod schemas; nine ax-engine endpoints use resolver(z.any()), so the SDK and OpenAPI drift gate cannot see their shapes (F2).
stepNotes.6: No layer violation (no direct SQLite/Drizzle/LSP access); shouldShowProviderInList is a correctly-extracted pure helper tested across three test files; lazy() registry defers construction.
stepNotes.7: hasApiKey boolean expression triplicated at :148/:163/:172 (F3); AxEnginePrepareBody vs AxEngineStartBody kept separate is defensible; download passes body.quantization raw while delete normalizes — readability asymmetry only.
stepNotes.8: Findings: F1 MEDIUM (prepare/start leak AX_ENGINE domain errors as 500, contract mismatch with declared errors(400)); F2 MEDIUM (nine resolver(z.any()) response schemas); F3 LOW (hasApiKey triplication). Zero Critical/High.
stepNotes.9: Corroborated against provider-routes.test.ts (filter, OAuth 400, schema coercion, attach->managed credential round-trip, unknown-model 400, delete 400, redactProviderInfo). No Critical findings so no reverify.md emitted; unit ready for codex-sol independent pass.
